nominee.longerDescription: Happy Woman Crush Wednesday! The first image you see is what I saw on my IG feed 2 days ago, and I was so impressed I had to investigate. Finally I found a WW with my favorite name, and I think she's really cute. She's into rock music, whoch is not my favorite, but it fits her vibe. I found no evidence of a boyfriend, but she has a ton of pictures like that with who I assume is her younger brother, and it's lowkey sus.
